correctness.rationale: The surviving affine-class and Walsh statements are correct. Feng et al.'s track decomposition puts each permutation with effective odd block length ell in the affine class of chi_ell^(x d), every divisor ell>1 of the odd part n0 occurs, and inverse degree (ell+1)/2 distinguishes different ell, giving exactly tau(n0)-1 classes. For a Cartesian product, the vectorial Walsh transform factors blockwise. With at least one nonzero output-mask block, the maximum is attained by activating one best block and taking zero masks on the others, so Lambda(P)=2^(n-ell)Lambda(chi_ell). Invertible affine changes preserve Walsh magnitudes up to reindexing/sign.

originality.rationale: The original structural novelty claim is stale: arXiv:2609.19548v2, revised 21 September, explicitly added the interleaved-track/stretching decomposition and elementary equivalence of the two canonical generalized families. The earlier 18 September SCOPE repaired record also already contains the inherited order, inverse-degree, DDT, exact differential-uniformity, and no-cross-track-diffusion consequences. The repair narrows this record to the exact divisor-indexed affine-class count and the closed Walsh/normalized linear-correlation scaling, which were not found in the v2 remarks or the earlier SCOPE record.

scientific_value.rationale: The residual contribution is modest but useful: it compresses the complete parameter family to exactly tau(n0)-1 affine types and shows that enlarging the ambient state by parallel repetition does not improve normalized maximum linear correlation. The repair presents these as short invariant deductions rather than as discovery of the block decomposition.
